name: TOLOM
description: Vertical operating system for auto service businesses — multi-tenant SaaS platform for garage management covering CRM, work orders, inventory, finance, and reporting.

modules.name: bay-view
modules.description: Garage bay/workstation view for tracking active jobs

modules.name: customers
modules.description: Customer CRM with notes, vehicle ownership, and service history

modules.name: vehicles
modules.description: Vehicle records with plate number, VIN, make/model, and service schedules

modules.name: work-orders
modules.description: Multi-step work order wizard with line items, mechanic assignment, and status tracking

modules.name: services
modules.description: Service catalog with default pricing, price memory, and interval-based scheduling

modules.name: inventory
modules.description: Ledger-based inventory with stock movements, low-stock alerts, and purchase orders

modules.name: finance
modules.description: Invoices, payments, estimates, and revenue reporting

modules.name: mechanic
modules.description: Mechanic performance, daily/weekly/monthly reports, and commission tracking

modules.name: reports
modules.description: Business intelligence dashboards with KPIs and period-based analytics

modules.name: service-reminders
modules.description: Vehicle service interval tracking with cron-driven reminder system

modules.name: organization
modules.description: Multi-tenant org settings, branch management, and user roles

modules.name: settings
modules.description: Application settings, theme, and user preferences

modules.name: vehicle-models
modules.description: Global reference catalogs for car brands, models, and engine types

principles: RLS on all tables without exception
Inventory must be ledger-based, never direct quantity updates
Feature flags and settings over hard-coding
One core product + configuration, not custom builds per client
methodology.commitStyle: atomic, one logical change per commit

painPoints.description: TypeScript types must be regenerated after every migration. Importing from database.types.ts directly breaks on regeneration — all imports must go through @/lib/types.
Both mn.json and en.json must be updated together. Missing translations cause fallback keys to appear in the UI.
painPoints.mitigation: AGENTS.md rule requires dual-file updates for any UI string change
